name: Google Chat
label: Google Chat — Google Chat API v1
description: Google Chat via the official Google Chat API v1. Base https://chat.googleapis.com/v1. Docs: https://developers.google.com/workspace/chat/api/reference/rest. Chat app must be installed in the space. Workspace admin allow-list. listen = Chat/Workspace Events as BPMN message events. Customer-level preview subscriptions are out of v1. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Chat operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: create-message | get-message | update-message | delete-message | list-messages | get-membership | list-memberships | get-space | list-spaces | send-and-wait | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: parent
schema.description: Space resource name, e.g. spaces/AAAA. Used as {parent}. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Resource name spaces/{space}/messages/{message} or members/spaces. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Plain text body. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: updateMask
schema.description: Field mask for update-message, e.g. text. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: messageReplyOption
schema.description: Query-string parameter `messageReplyOption` for operation: create-message.

schema.label: cardsV2
schema.description: Request-body parameter `cardsV2` for operations: create-message, update-message.

schema.label: thread
schema.description: Request-body parameter `thread` for operation: create-message.

schema.label: pageSize
schema.description: Query-string parameter `pageSize` for operations: list-messages, list-memberships, list-spaces.

schema.label: pageToken
schema.description: Query-string parameter `pageToken` for operations: list-messages, list-memberships, list-spaces.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Query-string parameter `filter` for operation: list-spaces.

schema.label: Client message id
schema.description: create-message query messageId (spaces/*/messages/{id} client-assigned). Example: client-abc.

schema.label: Request id
schema.description: create-message query requestId — idempotency key.

schema.label: Show deleted
schema.description: list-messages showDeleted.

schema.label: Order by
schema.description: list-messages orderBy. Example: createTime DESC.

schema.label: Show groups
schema.description: list-memberships showGroups.

schema.label: Show invited
schema.description: list-memberships showInvited.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-message, get-message, update-message, delete-message, list-messages, get-membership, list-memberships, get-space, list-spaces, send-and-wait, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: OAuth access token
configurationParameters.description: Google OAuth access token or Chat app service-account token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) supporting URL key, X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header, or k/{keyId} with provider secret header.

configurationParameters.label: Chat App Verification Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header Authorization. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
configurationParameters.description: HTTP header name carrying the provider webhook secret (default: Authorization).
